title: coap_codec native_sim link failure: undefined lichen_coap_serialize/lichen_coap_parse (plus COAP_CLIENT_THREAD_PRIORITY class)
description: Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-oi7g verification. lichen/tests/coap_codec fails at LINK on native_sim/native/64: undefined reference to lichen_coap_serialize (main.c:157,164,169) and lichen_coap_parse (main.c:32,77,79) — the codec source is not linked into the test (same merge-skew class as the coap_respond.c fix in 816482840c). ALSO: coap_codec, coap_keys, coap_lci_auth, coap_oscore_fallback, coap_server_config all enable LICHEN_COAP_CLIENT without CONFIG_COAP_CLIENT_THREAD_PRIORITY=14, so once they link they will hit the same z_init_static_threads 'invalid priority (15)' panic fixed for tunnel_auth_zephyr in this round (Zephyr default = NUM_PREEMPT_PRIORITIES = K_IDLE_PRIO). Fix: link the codec source, and add the priority override to all five prj.confs (pattern in lichen/tests/coap_client/prj.conf:15 and ping_l2/prj.conf:58).
